abstract: Comprehensive best practices guide for Intershop Commerce Management (ICM) backend development, designed for AI agents and LLMs. Contains 50+ rules across 8 categories, prioritized by impact from critical (customization patterns, performance optimization, B2B features) to incremental (advanced patterns). Each rule includes detailed explanations, real-world examples comparing incorrect vs. correct implementations, and specific impact metrics to guide automated refactoring and code generation.
